rules.rule: Never changes or removes a set key, its value, or any other line
must: Never\ change\ or\ remove\ a\ key\ the\ file\ sets,\ its\ value,\ or\ any\ other\ line

rules.rule: Server keys are kept as found and written only into a new file
must: keep\ `mcp\-server`,\ `mcp\-port`,\ `watch`,\ and\ `watch\-debounce`\ as\ found,\ and\ write\ them\ only\ into\ a\ new\ file

rules.rule: One proposal of the whole front matter, then one question
must: Propose\ once:\ the\ whole\ front\ matter\ as\ it\ will\ be
Ask\ one\ question:\ write\ it\ as\ shown,\ or\ which\ values\ to\ change

rules.rule: A required key not found blocks the write, even after a yes
must: still\ `not\ found`\ blocks\ the\ write:\ ask\ for\ its\ value,\ even\ after\ a\ yes

rules.rule: Skips the gate and calls no server tool
must: Call\ no\ server\ tool,\ start\ no\ server,\ and\ never\ touch\ `\.mcp\.json`
Report\ tersely:\ no\ preamble\ or\ narration

rules.rule: The key reference is copied verbatim and appended once
must: Skip\ it\ when\ the\ body\ already\ has\ a\ `\#\#\ Front\ matter\ keys`\ heading\ or\ a\ table\ row\ naming\ `mcp\-server`

rules.rule: check writes nothing, fixes nothing, and calls only read tools
must: `check`\ is\ read\-only:\ it\ writes\ nothing\ and\ fixes\ nothing\ in\ the\ project

rules.rule: check never stops at the first problem; without a server it reports and continues
must: Run\ every\ check\ below;\ never\ stop\ at\ the\ first\ problem\.
report\ it\ as\ a\ problem,\ and\ report\ the\ lines\ that\ need\ the\ server\ as\ `not\ checked`

rules.rule: counts are read off the server's answers
must: Read\ every\ count\ off\ the\ server's\ answers,\ never\ estimate\ one\.
